_comment: Generated by apps/web/scripts/report-fixtures.mjs from the astro engine; never hand-edited.

mangal.rule: Mars in these whole-sign houses from the lagna or from the Moon. No cancellation (parihara) rules are applied in v1.

kaal_sarp.rule: Present when all seven planets lie strictly on one side of the Rahu-Ketu axis. Type is named by Rahu's whole-sign house from the lagna.

sade_sati.rule: Saturn transiting the 12th, 1st and 2nd sidereal signs counted from the natal Moon sign.

settings.sunrise_convention: upper limb, standard refraction (1013.25 hPa, 15 °C), sea level

meta.time_contract: instants in UTC plus an IANA zone; format at the edge
